top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by designed heterobifunctional molecules is a new design principle (induced proximity to an E3 ligase, with quantifiable ternary-complex cooperativity), confirmed across many laboratories, and not covered by any earlier prize. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated it and Ciulli's structure-guided VHL ligands made it a quantitative design discipline, so the three-name allocation keeps the citation within a single achievement and leaves the cereblon glue strand for a separate future case. The main reservation is that no degrader is yet an approved drug. I still prefer this to the alternatives, where B008 is clean but close to 2010, and the base-editing and condensate cases have weaker novelty, attribution or maturity.
